title: julyx10/lap
title_zh: Lap - 私人本地照片管理器

paragraphs.en: An offline-first photo manager for large local libraries
paragraphs.zh: 一个面向大型本地照片库的离线优先照片管理器

paragraphs.en: Lap is an open-source, local-first photo manager for browsing family albums, finding old photos quickly, and managing large personal media libraries offline. It is a privacy-focused alternative to cloud photo services: no forced upload, local AI search, folder-first workflow, and free to use.
paragraphs.zh: Lap 是一款开源、本地优先的照片管理软件，可用于浏览家庭相册、快速查找老照片，以及离线管理大型个人媒体库。 它是云照片服务的隐私优先替代方案：无强制上传、本地 AI 搜索、以文件夹为先的工作流程，并且免费使用。

sents.en: Lap is an open-source, local-first photo manager for browsing family albums, finding old photos quickly, and managing large personal media libraries offline.
sents.zh: Lap 是一款开源、本地优先的照片管理软件，可用于浏览家庭相册、快速查找老照片，以及离线管理大型个人媒体库。

sents.en: It is a privacy-focused alternative to cloud photo services: no forced upload, local AI search, folder-first workflow, and free to use.
sents.zh: 它是云照片服务的隐私优先替代方案：无强制上传、本地 AI 搜索、以文件夹为先的工作流程，并且免费使用。

paragraphs.en: Open the latest release page , then download the file that matches your system:
paragraphs.zh: 打开最新版本发布页面，然后下载与你的系统相匹配的文件：

paragraphs.en: brew tap julyx10/lap brew install --cask lap Screenshots
paragraphs.zh: brew tap julyx10/lap brew install --cask lap 截图

paragraphs.en: Lap is folder-first, but not every piece of information shown in Lap is embedded in the original file. This distinction matters when you also manage the same folders in Finder, Explorer, or another photo app.
paragraphs.zh: Lap 以文件夹为先，但并非显示在 Lap 中的每一条信息都嵌入在原始文件里。 当你同时在 Finder、资源管理器或其他照片应用中管理相同文件夹时，这一区别很重要。

sents.en: Lap is folder-first, but not every piece of information shown in Lap is embedded in the original file.
sents.zh: Lap 以文件夹为先，但并非显示在 Lap 中的每一条信息都嵌入在原始文件里。

sents.en: This distinction matters when you also manage the same folders in Finder, Explorer, or another photo app.
sents.zh: 当你同时在 Finder、资源管理器或其他照片应用中管理相同文件夹时，这一区别很重要。

paragraphs.en: This data does not travel with a file when it is copied, exported, or moved outside Lap, and it is not available automatically to other applications.
paragraphs.zh: 此数据在文件被复制、导出或移出 Lap 时不会随之移动，也不会自动提供给其他应用程序。

paragraphs.en: Lap can rescan folders and detect many filesystem changes. But changes made outside Lap—such as renaming, moving, replacing, or copying files—can disrupt organization that is stored only in Lap.
paragraphs.zh: Lap 可以重新扫描文件夹并检测到许多文件系统更改。 但在 Lap 之外所做的更改——例如重命名、移动、替换或复制文件——可能会破坏仅存储在 Lap 中的组织结构。

sents.en: Lap can rescan folders and detect many filesystem changes.
sents.zh: Lap 可以重新扫描文件夹并检测到许多文件系统更改。

sents.en: But changes made outside Lap—such as renaming, moving, replacing, or copying files—can disrupt organization that is stored only in Lap.
sents.zh: 但在 Lap 之外所做的更改——例如重命名、移动、替换或复制文件——可能会破坏仅存储在 Lap 中的组织结构。

paragraphs.en: For the most reliable results, rename and move files in Lap whenever you rely on Collections, Tags, Comments, Favorites, Ratings, or culling states. If you also manage files outside Lap, back up Lap's database and configuration together with your photos. You can manage the database location and create a backup in Settings → Storage .
paragraphs.zh: 为获得最可靠的结果，凡是在依赖收藏集、标签、注释、收藏、评分或筛选状态时，请始终在 Lap 内进行文件的重命名和移动操作。 如果您还在 Lap 之外管理文件，请将 Lap 的数据库和配置与您的照片一起备份。 您可以在 设置 → 存储中管理数据库位置并创建备份。

sents.en: For the most reliable results, rename and move files in Lap whenever you rely on Collections, Tags, Comments, Favorites, Ratings, or culling states.
sents.zh: 为获得最可靠的结果，凡是在依赖收藏集、标签、注释、收藏、评分或筛选状态时，请始终在 Lap 内进行文件的重命名和移动操作。

sents.en: If you also manage files outside Lap, back up Lap's database and configuration together with your photos.
sents.zh: 如果您还在 Lap 之外管理文件，请将 Lap 的数据库和配置与您的照片一起备份。

sents.en: You can manage the database location and create a backup in Settings → Storage .
sents.zh: 您可以在 设置 → 存储中管理数据库位置并创建备份。

paragraphs.en: Deleting Lap's database or configuration removes this local organization and index data, but does not delete your original media files.
paragraphs.zh: 删除 Lap 的数据库或配置会移除这些本地组织和索引数据，但不会删除您的原始媒体文件。

paragraphs.en: Lap works directly with your existing photo folders. Uninstalling Lap, or deleting its database and cache files, does not delete your original photos.
paragraphs.zh: Lap 可直接配合你现有的照片文件夹使用。 卸载 Lap，或删除其数据库和缓存文件，并不会删除你的原始照片。

sents.en: Lap works directly with your existing photo folders.
sents.zh: Lap 可直接配合你现有的照片文件夹使用。

sents.en: Uninstalling Lap, or deleting its database and cache files, does not delete your original photos.
sents.zh: 卸载 Lap，或删除其数据库和缓存文件，并不会删除你的原始照片。

paragraphs.en: The standard uninstall steps remove the application. To remove Lap completely, quit Lap first, uninstall the application, then delete its local database, thumbnail cache, and configuration files using the cleanup command for your platform.
paragraphs.zh: 标准卸载步骤可移除该应用程序。 要彻底移除 Lap，请先退出 Lap，卸载该应用程序，然后使用适合您平台的清理命令删除其本地数据库、缩略图缓存和配置文件。

sents.en: The standard uninstall steps remove the application.
sents.zh: 标准卸载步骤可移除该应用程序。

sents.en: To remove Lap completely, quit Lap first, uninstall the application, then delete its local database, thumbnail cache, and configuration files using the cleanup command for your platform.
sents.zh: 要彻底移除 Lap，请先退出 Lap，卸载该应用程序，然后使用适合您平台的清理命令删除其本地数据库、缩略图缓存和配置文件。

paragraphs.en: brew uninstall --cask lap For a manual installation, quit Lap and move Lap.app from the Applications folder to the Trash.
paragraphs.zh:
brew uninstall --cask lap
如需手动安装，请退出 Lap，并将 Applications 文件夹中的 Lap.app 移到废纸篓。

paragraphs.en: To remove all Lap database, cache, and configuration files:
paragraphs.zh: 要删除所有 Lap 数据库、缓存和配置文件：

paragraphs.en: rm -rf " $HOME /Library/Application Support/com.julyx10.lap " \ " $HOME /Library/Caches/com.julyx10.lap " \ " $HOME /Library/WebKit/com.julyx10.lap " rm -f " $HOME /Library/Preferences/com.julyx10.lap.plist " Windows Open Settings > Apps > Installed apps , find Lap , and select Uninstall .
paragraphs.zh: rm -rf " $HOME /Library/Application Support/com.julyx10.lap " \ " $HOME /Library/Caches/com.julyx10.lap " \ " $HOME /Library/WebKit/com.julyx10.lap " rm -f " $HOME /Library/Preferences/com.julyx10.lap.plist " Windows 打开「设置」>「应用」>「已安装的应用」，找到 Lap ，并选择「卸载」。

paragraphs.en: Then open PowerShell and remove all Lap database, cache, and configuration files:
paragraphs.zh: 然后打开 PowerShell 并删除所有 Lap 数据库、缓存和配置文件：

paragraphs.en: Remove-Item - Recurse - Force - ErrorAction SilentlyContinue " $ env: LOCALAPPDATA \com.julyx10.lap " Remove-Item - Recurse - Force - ErrorAction SilentlyContinue " $ env: APPDATA \com.julyx10.lap " Linux For DEB installations, uninstall the package:
paragraphs.zh: Remove-Item - Recurse - Force - ErrorAction SilentlyContinue " $ env: LOCALAPPDATA \com.julyx10.lap " Remove-Item - Recurse - Force - ErrorAction SilentlyContinue " $ env: APPDATA \com.julyx10.lap " Linux 对于 DEB 安装，卸载该软件包：

paragraphs.en: sudo apt remove lap For AppImage installations, quit Lap and delete the downloaded .AppImage file.
paragraphs.zh: sudo apt remove lap 对于 AppImage 安装方式，请退出 Lap 并删除已下载的 .AppImage 文件。

paragraphs.en: Then remove all Lap database, cache, and configuration files:
paragraphs.zh: 然后删除所有 Lap 数据库、缓存和配置文件：

paragraphs.en: rm -rf " $HOME /.local/share/com.julyx10.lap " \ " $HOME /.cache/com.julyx10.lap " \ " $HOME /.config/com.julyx10.lap " If you selected a custom database storage directory in Lap settings, delete that directory separately after confirming that it contains only Lap database files.
paragraphs.zh:
```
rm -rf " $HOME /.local/share/com.julyx10.lap " \
" $HOME /.cache/com.julyx10.lap " \
" $HOME /.config/com.julyx10.lap "
```

如果你在 Lap 设置中选择了自定义数据库存储目录，请在确认该目录仅包含 Lap 数据库文件后，再单独删除该目录。

paragraphs.en: Requirements: Node.js 20+, pnpm, Rust stable.
paragraphs.zh: 要求：Node.js 20+、pnpm、Rust stable。

paragraphs.en: # macOS system deps xcode-select --install brew install nasm pkg-config autoconf automake libtool cmake # Linux system deps # sudo apt install libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libappindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev \ # patchelf nasm clang pkg-config autoconf automake libtool cmake # Clone and build git clone --recursive https://github.com/julyx10/lap.git cd lap git submodule update --init --recursive cargo install tauri-cli --version " ^2.0.0 " --locked ./scripts/download_models.sh # Windows: .\scripts\download_models.ps1 ./scripts/download_ffmpeg_sidecar.sh # Windows: .\scripts\download_ffmpeg_sidecar.ps1 cd src-vite && pnpm install && cd .. cargo tauri dev Distribution packages can link against the system libheif (1.17 or newer) instead of the bundled libheif and libde265. Set LAP_SYSTEM_LIBHEIF=1 for the build. The submodules third_party/libheif and third_party/libde265 are then not needed. HEVC decoding depends on the codec plugins of the system libheif.
paragraphs.zh: # macOS 系统依赖 xcode-select --install brew install nasm pkg-config autoconf automake libtool cmake # Linux 系统依赖 # sudo apt install libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libappindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev \ # patchelf nasm clang pkg-config autoconf automake libtool cmake # 克隆并构建 git clone --recursive https://github.com/julyx10/lap.git cd lap git submodule update --init --recursive cargo install tauri-cli --version " ^2.0.0 " --locked ./scripts/download_models.sh # Windows: .\scripts\download_models.ps1 ./scripts/download_ffmpeg_sidecar.sh # Windows: .\scripts\download_ffmpeg_sidecar.ps1 cd src-vite && pnpm install && cd .. cargo tauri dev 发行版软件包可以链接系统的 libheif（1.17 或更新版本），而不用捆绑的 libheif 和 libde265。 构建时设置 LAP_SYSTEM_LIBHEIF=1。 这样就不需要 third_party/libheif 和 third_party/libde265 这两个子模块。 HEVC 解码依赖于系统 libheif 的编解码器插件。

sents.en: # macOS system deps xcode-select --install brew install nasm pkg-config autoconf automake libtool cmake # Linux system deps # sudo apt install libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libappindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev \ # patchelf nasm clang pkg-config autoconf automake libtool cmake # Clone and build git clone --recursive https://github.com/julyx10/lap.git cd lap git submodule update --init --recursive cargo install tauri-cli --version " ^2.0.0 " --locked ./scripts/download_models.sh # Windows: .\scripts\download_models.ps1 ./scripts/download_ffmpeg_sidecar.sh # Windows: .\scripts\download_ffmpeg_sidecar.ps1 cd src-vite && pnpm install && cd .. cargo tauri dev Distribution packages can link against the system libheif (1.17 or newer) instead of the bundled libheif and libde265.
sents.zh: # macOS 系统依赖 xcode-select --install brew install nasm pkg-config autoconf automake libtool cmake # Linux 系统依赖 # sudo apt install libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev libappindicator3-dev librsvg2-dev \ # patchelf nasm clang pkg-config autoconf automake libtool cmake # 克隆并构建 git clone --recursive https://github.com/julyx10/lap.git cd lap git submodule update --init --recursive cargo install tauri-cli --version " ^2.0.0 " --locked ./scripts/download_models.sh # Windows: .\scripts\download_models.ps1 ./scripts/download_ffmpeg_sidecar.sh # Windows: .\scripts\download_ffmpeg_sidecar.ps1 cd src-vite && pnpm install && cd .. cargo tauri dev 发行版软件包可以链接系统的 libheif（1.17 或更新版本），而不用捆绑的 libheif 和 libde265。

sents.en: Set LAP_SYSTEM_LIBHEIF=1 for the build.
sents.zh: 构建时设置 LAP_SYSTEM_LIBHEIF=1。

sents.en: The submodules third_party/libheif and third_party/libde265 are then not needed.
sents.zh: 这样就不需要 third_party/libheif 和 third_party/libde265 这两个子模块。

sents.en: HEVC decoding depends on the codec plugins of the system libheif.
sents.zh: HEVC 解码依赖于系统 libheif 的编解码器插件。

paragraphs.en: Lap supports 60+ photo, RAW, and video formats.
paragraphs.zh: Lap 支持 60 多种照片、RAW 和视频格式。
